images.caption: Figure 1:Three diagnostics of Cross-Tokenizer OPD for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct→\rightarrowLlama-3.2-3B-Instruct.Left:The logged student-side alignment ratio remains high during Strict full training despite substantially lower static vocabulary overlap.Middle:Adding supervision on mismatch groups lowers mathematics and code performance.Right:At strictly aligned positions in student-generated responses before distillation, the shared vocabulary retains nearly all teacher and student probability mass on average, and a student-selected top-16 subset retains most of it on both sides.
